correction_to_prior_receipts.explanation: lane-A.md and plan-brief.md cite 57,247 embeddable messages. That count was taken WITHOUT the visibility predicate: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE role IN ('user','assistant') AND length(content) >= 50 returns 57,250 today. With visibility_sql applied - which the plan requires, since a hidden session must never be embedded or returned - the embeddable set is 51,729 across 4,600 of 5,879 sessions. Every projection in this receipt uses 51,729.

material_threshold: The plan defines overflow as material when > 5% of embeddable messages exceed the model's token cap. All three candidates exceed it (15.65% - 21.8%), so chunking is required whichever model Stage 4 picks.

tokenizer_finding.claim: All three candidates segment this corpus identically, so token-cap overflow differs ONLY by each model's configured cap.
tokenizer_finding.evidence: Independent check with three separate tokenizer objects (BertTokenizer vocab 30522 x2, MPNetTokenizer vocab 30527) over the first 300 sample texts: total token count 257,305 for all three, per-text counts equal.
tokenizer_finding.mechanism: lowercase WordPiece over the same 30,522-entry base vocabulary.

unverified.reason: all three models were already in the local HF cache (~/.cache/huggingface/hub), so no network fetch was exercised. Cold-load seconds are disk load + init, NOT download.

unverified.reason: measured on random unit vectors in an in-memory database. Real embeddings cluster, and an on-disk file adds page/WAL overhead, so treat these as an order-of-magnitude floor, not the shipped figure.
